summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors approved the Final Investment Decision for the RPBC Biorefining project, a new plant for bio-jet fuel and renewable diesel at the Presidente Bernardes Refinery. The estimated investment is approximately US$1.2 billion, with construction expected to begin by end of 2026 and start-up scheduled for 2030. The plant will have capacity of up to 15,000 bpd. This is a routine capital investment disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
